nodes.label: Suppress Expected Hydration Mismatches
nodes.rationale: Some server/client differences (random IDs, dates, locale/timezone formatting) are expected; suppressHydrationWarning silences noisy warnings for these only — must not be used to hide real bugs or overused. Impact: LOW-MEDIUM.

nodes.label: suppressHydrationWarning
nodes.rationale: React DOM attribute that silences hydration warnings for expected server/client differences only — not a tool to hide real bugs.
